notes: An unmounted player receives the exact refusal and the ignored argument is not parsed.
A mounted player receives the exact hop-off line before the room act.
The TO_ROOM act reaches the mounted player's peer with the native horse substitution.
An arbitrary argument does not alter either mounted or unmounted command behavior.

The rider and mount AFF_MOUNT flags clear, while C unmount retains the mount's master/follower relation. Tests cover the direct dismount, legacy wrappers including a NULL rider, recall and jail relocation, and separately clear MountRider only when follower teardown removes the actual relation.
